title: Razor Syntax Basics
description: Use Razor syntax for dynamic content, loops, conditions, and inline expressions.

data.text: Use Razor syntax for dynamic content, loops, conditions, and inline expressions.
**Scenario:** Configure or implement the described functionality in an ASP.NET Core application.
Use @ to embed C# code in HTML. Use @: for plain text and <text> for markup without wrapper elements.

data.title: Razor Code Expressions

data.text: Extract reusable UI into partial views and render them with Html.PartialAsync or Html.RenderPartialAsync.

data.title: Razor Partial Views
data.code:
@model Product

@Model.Name

@Model.Description

@Model.Price.ToString("C")
@foreach (var product in Model.Products) { } @foreach (var product in Model.Products) { @Html.PartialAsync("_ProductCard", product) }

cards.title: Razor Code Expressions
pros: Clean mixing of HTML and C#

cards.title: Razor Partial Views
cons: Partial views don't have separate lifecycle
